mapper.select: SELECT * FROM users WHERE role = #{role} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY name
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (name, email, password_hash, phone, role, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{phone}, #{role}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET name = #{name}, email = #{email}, password_hash = #{passwordHash}, phone = #{phone}, role = #{role}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE users SET deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
